name: Ribbon
decision: D15 (open; the Ribbon proposal is the working default)

paper.use: Page background: India paper by day, warm soot by night

ink.use: Body text and headings: lamp-black ink by day, lamplight by night

rubric.use: The one accent: rubrics, red initials, red-letter days, source marks, and the primary action

onRubric.use: Text and symbols on rubric fills

gilt.use: Ornament only: hairlines, the ribbon edge, the atlas plate; never text

ribbon.note: Season markers (P2.5, P4.8): always beside the season's or colour's name, never colour alone, never a theme or a text colour. Most prayer books prescribe no colours, so the app labels them as custom. Ribbons marked edge: gilt fall below 3:1 against paper and are drawn with a gilt hairline edge.

contrast.note: WCAG 2 contrast ratios, computed 2026-10-28. AA needs 4.5 for text; 3 for ornament and ribbons (non-text). P2.3 recomputes these in a test.

serif.family: To be chosen in P2.4: Libre Caslon Text or Baskervville (both SIL OFL 1.1)
serif.fallback: The system serif (New York) until P2.4 bundles the chosen face
serif.use: Liturgical text, Scripture, titles, and headings

interface.use: Buttons, tabs, labels, settings, eyebrows, source text, and page numbers in controls

display.use: The day's name on Today; screen titles

heading.use: Headings within an office; card titles

rubric.use: Rubrics: instructions, never words to be said; red or italic by setting

initial.use: The red initial that opens a prayer or section

role.use: Role labels: Minister, Priest, Officiant, People, Answer

pageNumber.use: Printed page numbers in the margin

sourceMark.use: The mark that opens a source sheet
